_style: Create an image: vertical 2:3 mobile puzzle game background. {scene} Painterly digital illustration, rich glowing jewel colours, gentle depth of field, magical and cosy. The middle of the picture is calm, simple and slightly darker, because a grid of gems will sit on top of it; the interesting detail is at the top and bottom edges. No text, no logos, no UI, no characters, no loose gems in the foreground.
title: A magical treasure vault deep in a mountain: heaps of glittering cut gems and gold coins at the bottom, a tall arched cave opening at the top with warm golden light pouring in, floating sparkles. (Gems are welcome in this one, but only at the very bottom.)
map: A long winding path of glowing stepping stones climbing from a crystal cave at the bottom, past a sunken lagoon, desert dunes, a night forest and a volcano, up to a starry sky with a nebula at the top, seen as one tall dreamy panorama.
